name: particles
description: View-side particle plumbing. A ParticleManager owns a registered set of IParticleEmitter instances and ticks them each frame; a ParticleBudget arbitrates a global cap shared across world (THREE) and HUD (Pixi) emitters. WorldParticleEmitter (THREE.Group) and HudParticleEmitter (Pixi.Container) provide pooled, behavior-driven emitter base classes; ParticleBurstTrack drives an emitter from the timeline module.
